technical_delta: Exactly two recomputed raw-norm-scaled destination tangent targets are fitted by affine ridge around the current centered-Procrustes map and accumulated into one normalized document adapter for native destination queries and anchor-inclusive replacement.
rationale: A concrete incremental composition and scoped empirical finding remain after removing established translation, cosine geometry, affine algebra and mixed-gallery ingredients. No inspected named publication contains the exact update; close GCPA conceptual overlap requires citation and narrower positioning, not abandonment.

strongest_rejection: GCPA already corrects directional mismatch after Procrustes while retaining geometry; HMoE controls residual directions and FastFill handles proxy replacement. ARC2 may be seen as a narrow linear cosine-optimization composition with a development-selected step count and no held Procrustes win.
smallest_response: Cite published GCPA and compare targets, coefficient prior, finite solves and inference explicitly; frame contribution as this computation plus scoped findings. Do not claim first angular refinement/mixed migration or superiority to unevaluated methods.

blindness.incidental_external_exposure: Search results included third-party summaries/review snippets (Pith/Moonlight/alphaXiv and aggregators) about adjacent papers; these were not used as technical evidence. Perfect blindness is not claimed.
